steps.why: install the tools the browser and its window need

steps.stdin:
Types: deb
URIs: https://packages.mozilla.org/apt
Suites: mozilla
Components: main
Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.mozilla.org.asc

steps.why: refresh the package lists with Mozilla's repository
let the home folder be entered

steps.stdin:
[Unit]
Description=Eidolon browser, with its automation socket on 127.0.0.1
Conflicts=eidolon-view.service
After=network.target

[Service]
User=eidolon
Group=eidolon
Environment=HOME=/home/eidolon
ExecStart=/usr/bin/firefox --headless --no-remote --profile /home/eidolon/profile --remote-debugging-port 9222
Restart=always
RestartSec=1

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=Eidolon sign-in window, the display
PartOf=eidolon-view.service

[Service]
User=eidolon
Group=eidolon
ExecStart=/usr/bin/Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1280x800x24 -nolisten tcp
Restart=on-failure

[Unit]
Description=Eidolon sign-in window, the screen share on 127.0.0.1
Requires=eidolon-xvfb.service
After=eidolon-xvfb.service
PartOf=eidolon-view.service

[Service]
User=eidolon
Group=eidolon
ExecStart=/usr/bin/x11vnc -display :99 -localhost -rfbport 5900 -passwdfile /run/eidolon/vnc.pass -forever -shared -noxdamage -quiet
Restart=on-failure

[Unit]
Description=Eidolon sign-in window, a browser a person can use (automation is off)
Requires=eidolon-xvfb.service eidolon-vnc.service
After=eidolon-xvfb.service eidolon-vnc.service
Conflicts=eidolon-browser.service

[Service]
User=eidolon
Group=eidolon
Environment=HOME=/home/eidolon
Environment=DISPLAY=:99
ExecStart=/usr/bin/firefox --no-remote --profile /home/eidolon/profile
Restart=on-failure
